concept.title: License Usage Monitoring
concept.shortdesc: Learn how the Seat Usage section shows license and storage consumption for an organization.

section.title: Seat Usage Information
section.p: The Seat Usage section provides real-time monitoring of license consumption.

dlentry.dd:
Shows the usage of Author licenses, which are user-based. The display includes:
The number of active Author users out of the total available.
A progress bar that shows the usage percentage.
A percentage value for quick reference.

Shows the usage of Subject-Matter Expert licenses, which use a floating seat model. The display includes:
The number of active SME users out of the total available.
A progress bar that shows the usage percentage.
A percentage value for quick reference.

section.p: License usage is calculated from these values:

ul.li: Active members - Users who are active in the organization.
Pending invitations - Users who were invited but did not yet accept.
Platform user role assignment - Whether users are assigned the Author or Subject-Matter Expert platform user role.

section.note: Inactive users do not count against license limits, but their data remains available and can be reactivated by an administrator.
